graphEvents.label: OpenBot memory model: per-bot versus shared
One store, two discriminators: formedBy and formedByBotId

label: OpenBot memory is a per-person fact store scoped to an organization, not a per-bot store.
Shared versus per-bot memory is one store with two discriminators: formedBy and formedByBotId; only the forming bot recalls a bot-formed fact.
The docs state the split: facts a person adds are shared with all bots, facts a bot picks up stay with that bot.
A memory carries reviewState unreviewed|confirmed|edited, and an unreviewed memory is never recalled until the person accepts it.
Pausing is a boolean (enabled:false) and a paused memory is never recalled; forgetting is a separate destructive operation.
Memory sources are per-bot app actions with toolRef, args, syncStatus, lastSyncAt and nextSyncAt; only the owning bot recalls what it read in.
Memory is organization-partitioned; a memory named from another organization is answered as not found.
A single-person OpenBot keeps no memory at all; memory is a team-edition primitive.
Where CopilotKit Intelligence is present it holds a copy of each accepted memory and does the recall; OpenBot keeps a thin record.
Skilled bots has no memory primitive: the BOT.md field set has no memory field, store path or recall hook.
The only memory mention in bots-author is the phrase never from memory, about the author own recall.
